Package it.polimi.ingsw.network.server

Class ServerSubject

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.server.ServerSubject
public class ServerSubject extends Object
Implements the observer pattern by interacting with the exchange handlers, notifying them about changes in the game model.
